native.runtime: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 CPU PhysX and one RTX renderer

software.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_bc_ppo.py tests/test_sharpa_learning_collect.py tests/test_sharpa_supermimic.py tests/test_sharpa_world_model.py -q
software.independent_actor_phase_resume_check: 4 WM + 2 actor/critic updates, resume to 4 WM + 4 actor/critic; weights, all optimizer states and next sampled batches match continuous run

limitations: Contact diagnostic freezes the contact pose; a stage named slide is not evidence of verified relative sliding.
Finger contact includes distal, middle phalanx and elastomer bodies; marker height is not collision penetration.
Simulated capacitive recognition is an uncalibrated force proxy.
Static composed Sharpa world joint is disabled; runtime still emits a disjoint-transform warning.
World-model prediction quality and autonomous control remain unvalidated.
